Transaction cache management for forks, blockhashes, insertion, query, and root advancement.

# Purpose
`fd_txncache.c` implements the transaction cache used to store and query transactions by fork and blockhash. It defines the private `fd_txncache_private` state, the internal `blockcache` structure, and the memory layout used for shared state, blockhash lookup tables, fork metadata, transaction pages, and free-page tracking. The file also provides the main lifecycle functions for the cache, including [`fd_txncache_align`](<#fd_txncache_align>), [`fd_txncache_footprint`](<#fd_txncache_footprint>), [`fd_txncache_new`](<#fd_txncache_new>), [`fd_txncache_join`](<#fd_txncache_join>), and [`fd_txncache_reset`](<#fd_txncache_reset>), which allocate, attach, and clear the cache data structures.

The rest of the file manages fork and transaction operations. It creates child forks with [`fd_txncache_attach_child`](<#fd_txncache_attach_child>), attaches and finalizes blockhash data with [`fd_txncache_attach_blockhash`](<#fd_txncache_attach_blockhash>) and [`fd_txncache_finalize_fork`](<#fd_txncache_finalize_fork>), advances the rooted fork chain with [`fd_txncache_advance_root`](<#fd_txncache_advance_root>), and inserts transactions with [`fd_txncache_insert`](<#fd_txncache_insert>). It also provides [`fd_txncache_query`](<#fd_txncache_query>) to test whether a transaction exists on a fork. The code uses read-write locks, atomic operations, hash buckets, linked lists, and per-blockhash transaction pages to support concurrent access and controlled reclamation of old forks and pages.
